title: KwaiKAT Team Releases KAT-Coder-V2.5: An Agentic Coding Model Trained on 100,000+ Verifiable Repository Environments
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: The KwaiKAT Team at Kuaishou has published the KAT-Coder-V2.5 technical report, arguing that agentic coding capability is bottlenecked by training infrastructure rather than model ...
body: The KwaiKAT team has released KAT-Coder-V2.5, an agentic coding model trained on over 100,000 verifiable programming tasks. KAT-Coder-V2.5 excels at multi-file repository refactoring, debugging, and self-correction. The model includes an advanced runtime validator that allows it to test and correct its own code suggestions before presenting them. This significantly reduces compilation errors and speeds up the development lifecycle for software engineers using AI coding assistants. The model sets a new standard for autonomous code generation. It provides a robust coding assistant for modern repository maintenance.
